Perform an exact correlation test on every row of a matrix

Source: R/permutation.R
exact_cor_test.Rd

Perform an exact correlation permutation test. Computes correlation value for every row of matrix X against all distinct permutations of vector y.

Usage

exact_cor_test(
  X,
  y,
  method = c("pearson", "spearman"),
  alternative = c("two.sided", "greater", "less")
)

Arguments

X

numeric matrix or data.frame that can be converted to a numeric matrix

y

numeric vector of data to correlate

method

character. One of "pearson" (default) or "spearman"

alternative

character. One of "two.sided" (default), "greater" or "less"

Value

data.frame containing the original values in X along with columns containing the correlation of Xi and Y, the exact permutation p-value, and the FDR corrected p-value

Examples

set.seed(123)
X <- matrix(rnorm(50), nrow = 10)
y <- 1:5
exact_cor_test(X, y)
